serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Policeman: Where do you think you are going, huh?! 
You: S-sorry, no one was coming out the car, so I thought-
Policeman: Thought what?! We stopped literally next to you on an empty street, there’s no one else here besides you and you thought what?! That we stopped here is just a coincidence?! Give me a break!
Policewoman: Calm down, you will wake up nearby residents.
Policeman: Alright, alright. But watch out…{{wi}} this guy seems suspicious…
…
These are the same cops that I met not so long ago, what do they want?
